canonical_source_rule: canonical state from handoff/repo readback/current artifacts only; memory is not canonical
problem_definition: preserve the independent post-failability-blocker route audit for MINIMAL-NON-CANDIDATE-SURFACE-ADMISSION-PREFLIGHT-001A as a repo-visible route record
real_trigger_evidence: preserved audit states it read repo-visible evidence, current artifacts, and docs/CLOSED_FAMILIES.md; memory is not canonical state
hypothesis: Preserving this route audit as a repo-visible route record reduces the chance of downstream work falling back into the governance-proxy loop or treating the downgraded preflight pass as route-forward evidence.
strongest_baseline: Without preservation, downstream tasks may see only the remote blocker boundary and still choose to redesign the same non-candidate admission preflight surface.

procedural_contrast.without_preservation: route decision remains conversation-local and may be lost
procedural_contrast.with_preservation: route decision becomes repo-visible and downstream-citable

trace_scope: optional remote branch/tag verification if Auto-Remote-Anchor conditions pass
route_warning: switch must not mean wrapping another behavior-bearing surface as a paper admission preflight; select a surface and define or execute behavior/state/output measurement later in a separate task
anti_zeno_stop_condition: if the next path still measures requirement presence, scope locks, manifest completeness, validator cleanliness, field presence, or report shape rather than concrete future behavior/state/output, close the route
